verdict.rationale: Increase is an API-first bank with a published OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, markdown docs and an official CLI. Accounts and account numbers are managed programmatically, Events can be pulled via the List Events API, holds and payment lifecycle states are tracked through network events, and the community praises how directly the REST API maps to the payment rails. Together this gives an agent a clean, non-scraping read surface for the core banking picture. missing for 10: explicit evidence of transaction and pending-transaction list endpoints, any document or statement retrieval API, an official MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of agent read workflows.
